Coastal Escape

Coca Beach

Open-air cottages, calm water and an easy stretch of sand — Sapao’s quieter coastal treasure.

About this place

One of Sapao’s quieter coastal treasures, known for its open-air cottages, calm atmosphere, and easy access from the barangay.

Coca Beach is an inviting choice for families or couples after a simple beach day away from the town center — a place to rest in the shade, swim in calm water, and stay until the light softens.

According to local stories, the beach became a community destination after the Sison family opened the area for public use, turning a private family space into a welcoming spot for gatherings and rest.

Key information

Cottage rental
₱500 – ₱1,000
Day-use access
₱10 per visitor
Getting there
Tricycle from Guiuan, then a short trail
Best for
Families, couples, quiet beach days

Rates were shared by the community and may change — confirm on arrival.

Location & directions

Getting to Coca Beach

From Guiuan town proper, take a tricycle along the barangay road to Sapao. The beach is reached by a short trail from the road.

Before you go

  • Bring small bills for the day-use fee and cottage rental.
  • Cottage availability can change on weekends and holidays — ask locally before you go.
  • Take your trash home with you; the beach is maintained by local families.
